say:2:1021516002:0.text: I can't see any traces of the bears, like their footprints or... Well, I can't tell which leaves on the ground belong to them!
say:2:1021516002:0.source_cn: 我没看到熊的踪迹，比如脚印或者……呃，我不知道地上哪种...
say:2:1021516002:0.male: I can't see any traces of the bears, like their footprints or... Well, I can't tell which leaves on the ground belong to them!
say:2:1021516002:0.female: I can't see any traces of the bears, like their footprints or... Well, I can't tell which leaves on the ground belong to them!

say:4:1021516003:0.text: This is weird. Hornleaf bears are usually quite common around here. Why doesn't any of them show up today?
say:4:1021516003:0.source_cn: 好奇怪，平时叶角熊很容易见到，为什么今天一只也没出现呢。
say:4:1021516003:0.male: This is weird. Hornleaf bears are usually quite common around here. Why doesn't any of them show up today?
say:4:1021516003:0.female: This is weird. Hornleaf bears are usually quite common around here. Why doesn't any of them show up today?

say:6:1021516004:0.text: Hmm... Could they be hiding somewhere to sip nectar? Or could they be taking a nap?
say:6:1021516004:0.source_cn: 嗯……难道是躲起来偷吃花蜜了？也有可能在睡觉？
say:6:1021516004:0.male: Hmm... Could they be hiding somewhere to sip nectar? Or could they be taking a nap?
say:6:1021516004:0.female: Hmm... Could they be hiding somewhere to sip nectar? Or could they be taking a nap?

say:7:1021516005:0.text: I suggest we take a walk through the bushes!
say:7:1021516005:0.source_cn: 我有个提议：也许我们该到草丛里走一走！
say:7:1021516005:0.male: I suggest we take a walk through the bushes!
say:7:1021516005:0.female: I suggest we take a walk through the bushes!

say:9:1021516007:0.text: Whenever I step through the bushes, some wild beasts will pop out to challenge me! Haven't you experienced something like that?
say:9:1021516007:0.source_cn: 你们没有这样的经验吗？只要走到草丛里，就会突然蹦出野生...
say:9:1021516007:0.male: Whenever I step through the bushes, some wild beasts will pop out to challenge me! Haven't you experienced something like that?
say:9:1021516007:0.female: Whenever I step through the bushes, some wild beasts will pop out to challenge me! Haven't you experienced something like that?

say:10:1021516008:0.text: If you're in luck, you might even come across a shiny variant with a color different from its peers. According to my calculations, the chance of encountering one is 1/4096!
say:10:1021516008:0.source_cn: 要是运气好，还能碰到闪闪发光的、和大多数同类颜色不一样...
say:10:1021516008:0.male: If you're in luck, you might even come across a shiny variant with a color different from its peers. According to my calculations, the chance of encountering one is 1/4096!
say:10:1021516008:0.female: If you're in luck, you might even come across a shiny variant with a color different from its peers. According to my calculations, the chance of encountering one is 1/4096!

say:11:1021516009:0.text: M—Magister, I'm struggling to follow her again!
say:11:1021516009:0.source_cn: 主、主人，满满又听不懂她在说什么了！
say:11:1021516009:0.male: M—Magister, I'm struggling to follow her again!
say:11:1021516009:0.female: M—Magister, I'm struggling to follow her again!

say:12:1021516010:0.text: I've never heard anything like that either...
say:12:1021516010:0.source_cn: 我也从来没有听说过这样的说法……
say:12:1021516010:0.male: I've never heard anything like that either...
say:12:1021516010:0.female: I've never heard anything like that either...

say:13:1021516011:0.text: Other smaller animals might be able to hide in the bushes, but I don't think one as big as a hornleaf bear can stay completely out of sight in there...
say:13:1021516011:0.source_cn: 如果是其他小型动物的话，可能的确会藏在草丛里。但是像叶...
say:13:1021516011:0.male: Other smaller animals might be able to hide in the bushes, but I don't think one as big as a hornleaf bear can stay completely out of sight in there...
say:13:1021516011:0.female: Other smaller animals might be able to hide in the bushes, but I don't think one as big as a hornleaf bear can stay completely out of sight in there...

say:14:1021516012:0.text: No, there is a boundless space within the bushes! Trust me!
say:14:1021516012:0.source_cn: 不，你要相信草丛里的空间是无限的。我向你保证！
say:14:1021516012:0.male: No, there is a boundless space within the bushes! Trust me!
say:14:1021516012:0.female: No, there is a boundless space within the bushes! Trust me!

say:17:1021516014:0.text: Alright... Since the Magister has spoken, Chippy will do it!
say:17:1021516014:0.source_cn: 好吧……既然主人都这样说了，满满一定完成任务！
say:17:1021516014:0.male: Alright... Since the Magister has spoken, Chippy will do it!
say:17:1021516014:0.female: Alright... Since the Magister has spoken, Chippy will do it!

say:18:1021516017:0.text: How about we split up so we can find the bear faster?
say:18:1021516017:0.source_cn: 为了尽快找到叶角熊，不如我们分开行动吧！
say:18:1021516017:0.male: How about we split up so we can find the bear faster?
say:18:1021516017:0.female: How about we split up so we can find the bear faster?

say:19:1021516018:0.text: Magister and Jaiden are on one team, Hammie and I on the other. We'll explore both ends of the valley separately. I'm sure we'll find the bears soon!
say:19:1021516018:0.source_cn: 主人和Jaiden一组，我和漫漫一组，分别向着峡谷两端...
say:19:1021516018:0.male: Magister and Jaiden are on one team, Hammie and I on the other. We'll explore both ends of the valley separately. I'm sure we'll find the bears soon!
say:19:1021516018:0.female: Magister and Jaiden are on one team, Hammie and I on the other. We'll explore both ends of the valley separately. I'm sure we'll find the bears soon!

say:23:1021516016:0.text: Hammie, there must be a reason Magister thinks that way. We just need to follow the instructions!
say:23:1021516016:0.source_cn: 漫漫，主人这样说一定有自己的道理，我们只需要照做就好！
say:23:1021516016:0.male: Hammie, there must be a reason Magister thinks that way. We just need to follow the instructions!
say:23:1021516016:0.female: Hammie, there must be a reason Magister thinks that way. We just need to follow the instructions!

choice:16:1:2.text: That makes a lot of sense! I'm impressed!
choice:16:1:2.male: That makes a lot of sense! I'm impressed!
choice:16:1:2.female: That makes a lot of sense! I'm impressed!
